title: Мясной король и ревнивая жена  (The Meat King and the Jealous Wife)

scenes.title: Партия в покер с олигархом  (A Poker Hand with an Oligarch)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov plays high-stakes poker against meat oligarch David Mikhailovich and beats his flush with four of a kind.

scenes.title: Разговор у машины Вики  (Conversation by Vika's Car)
scenes.summary: Vika nearly hits Max with her car; Max offers to raise the baby as his own, and when Vika tells him to leave, he overhears her phone call.

scenes.title: Ревность Марины в раздевалке  (Marina's Jealousy in the Locker Room)
scenes.summary: Senya's jealous wife Marina bursts into the locker room, finds a bra in Senya's sock drawer, and attacks Katya thinking they are having an affair.

scenes.title: Евгений Максимович Лавров  (Yevgeny Maximovich Lavrov)
scenes.summary: Max tells Vika he overheard her telling her sister that the baby is his, announces he is staying for his child, and takes her car keys.

scenes.title: Выигрыш в две тонны мяса  (Winnings of Two Tons of Meat)
scenes.summary: Barinov rehires Max and brags about beating an oligarch at poker, until his winnings arrive in the form of boxes of beef and pork carcasses.

scenes.title: Долг Лёве мясом  (Paying Lyova's Debt in Meat)
scenes.summary: Senya apologizes to Katya while his wife calls him every five minutes, and Barinov repays his cash debt to Lyova with slabs of meat.

scenes.title: Акция с двухкилограммовым антрекотом  (The Two-Kilogram Entrecote Promotion)
scenes.summary: Barinov proposes a promotion where anyone who finishes a two-kilogram steak eats for free, and bets Mikhail that nobody can eat two kilograms of meat.

scenes.title: Спор с Михаилом продолжается  (The Bet with Mikhail Continues)
scenes.summary: Unable to finish the massive steak himself, Mikhail agrees to let Barinov launch the promotion until he brings a guest who can eat the whole thing.

scenes.title: Марина устраивается уборщицей  (Marina Gets Hired as a Cleaner)
scenes.summary: Marina announces that Ainura hired her as a cleaner until the end of her vacation so she can keep an eye on Senya at work.

scenes.title: Водитель или хозяин отеля  (Driver or Hotel Owner)
scenes.summary: When Max comes to pick Vika up from yoga, Vika tells her friends he is her driver and a cook, so Max brags that he owns the hotel and restaurant.

scenes.title: Очередная ссора с Мариной  (Another Quarrel with Marina)
scenes.summary: Marina accuses Katya of kicking her mop bucket on purpose and forces Senya to shout at Katya that there will never be anything between them.

scenes.title: Спектакль Феди и Кати  (Fedya and Katya's Performance)
scenes.summary: While Mikhail cheers on the prefect eating the two-kilogram steak, Fedya and Katya stage a loud romantic confession so Marina will overhear.

scenes.title: Сеня застаёт Федю с Мариной  (Senya Catches Fedya with Marina)
scenes.summary: Following Katya's plan, Fedya kisses Marina so Senya will catch them and look like a hero defending his wife's honor.

scenes.title: Ужин за счёт хозяина отеля  (Dinner on the Hotel Owner)
scenes.summary: Vika brings her yoga classmates to the restaurant for a lavish dinner at Max's expense, complete with the most expensive bottle of red wine.

scenes.title: Сто двадцать граммов до победы  (One Hundred Twenty Grams from Victory)
scenes.summary: Vika instructs the waiter to give the dinner bill to Max, while Barinov and Mikhail discover that the prefect has collapsed in the restroom.

scenes.title: Диагноз переедание  (Diagnosis: Overeating)
scenes.summary: The doctor explains that overeating caused the prefect's collapse, Eleonora scolds Mikhail and Victor, and Barinov makes Mikhail eat the steak himself.

scenes.title: Примирение Сени и спасение Макса  (Senya's Reconciliation and Max's Rescue)
scenes.summary: Marina quits her job satisfied with Senya's devotion while Senya thanks Katya and Fedya, and Kostya saves Max from the dinner bill using the steak promotion.

scenes.title: Ультиматум Вики  (Vika's Ultimatum)
scenes.summary: Vika tells Max to get out of her life and threatens to demand that Chef Barinov fire him—or quit the restaurant herself.

scenes.title: Счёт за вино и тревога за ребёнка  (The Wine Bill and Worry for the Baby)
scenes.summary: Kostya reminds Max that the sixty-five-thousand-ruble bottle of wine was not free, while Vika interrupts Barinov's match and suddenly feels a sharp pain.

scenes.title: Наши маленькие слабости  (Our Little Weaknesses)
scenes.summary: Barinov congratulates Vika on her pregnancy, and later cheers for Elena's favorite football team at home as Max reflects on human weaknesses.
